title: Listen Closely, Respond to the Point
status: New proposed full-lesson production plan, not a recovered previously approved Lesson03 outline.
continuity: Lesson01 introduced observing a shared task and contributing. Lesson02 developed clear reasons and their limits. Lesson03 deepens listening, checking meaning and making a connected response.
boundaries: Seven sections fit these learning steps; seven is not mandatory for all future lessons.
Sustained disagreement, persuasion, negotiation and conflict repair are outside the lesson.
No generic requirement to paraphrase before every turn or include every response resource.
Original fictional examples are not real exam questions, official criteria or observed outcomes.
English silent review only; final recorded audio and localization are handled in the downstream production pass.

sections.title: Hear the View, Reason, and Concern
sections.learningOutcome: Identify what a speaker proposes, the reason offered and an expressed concern; preserve uncertainty and separate what was said from interpretation.

sections.title: Check Your Understanding
sections.learningOutcome: Use a brief, faithful paraphrase when a check is useful; retain the speaker’s purpose and uncertainty without adding a stronger claim.

sections.title: Ask the Question That Matters
sections.learningOutcome: Locate a consequential ambiguity and ask a focused clarification before giving a targeted response; distinguish clarification from repeating known information or advancing an ungrounded interpretation.

sections.title: Agree and Add Something Relevant
sections.learningOutcome: Make clear which part of a contribution you support, then add a relevant detail only if the discussion needs one.

sections.title: Respond to the Concern Within the Task
sections.learningOutcome: Address the actual concern without losing the shared objective or treating a partial response as a complete solution.

sections.title: Rehearse, Hear a Correction, and Adjust
sections.learningOutcome: Acknowledge a correction, update the understood concern, and offer a relevant next move without pretending that the learner has been recorded or assessed.

sections.title: Transfer and Review
sections.learningOutcome: Select a relevant listening or response move in a new context, without applying a rigid sequence or implying assessed mastery.
